abstract: OBJECTIVES: Our objective was to explore the pathologic components of residual masses after primary chemotherapy in patients with metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. METHODS: A multicenter retrospective study was conducted of 71 patients with thoracic residual masses (39 patients had bilateral lung metastasis) after first-line cisplatin-based chemotherapy for disseminated nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. Among the 71 patients, 52 also had a retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. RESULTS: Pathologic findings in postchemotherapy residual masses included complete necrosis, teratoma, and viable cancer in 31%, 55%, and 14% of patients, respectively. Discordant pathologic findings were evidenced between retroperitoneal lymph node and thoracic (lung or mediastinal lymph nodes) residual masses in 27% of patients. When a bilateral pulmonary resection was performed, only 2 (5%) of 39 patients had discordant histologic findings between the two lungs. Among patients who had necrosis only in residual masses from their first lung (n = 20), 19 (95%) also had necrosis only in contralateral lesions. A single patient had necrosis only in the first lung and some teratoma in the contralateral lung. CONCLUSIONS: This report shows a high rate (95%) of pathologic concordance between the two lungs. Avoiding contralateral lung surgery could therefore be considered when complete necrosis is found in the first lung after induction chemotherapy for nonseminomatous germ cell tumor.
abstract_ja:
目的：播種性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する一次化学療法後の残存腫瘤の病理学的構成要素を検討すること。
方法：播種性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する一次シスプラチン併用化学療法後に胸部残存腫瘤を有する71例（39例は両側肺転移）の多施設後方視的研究。71例のうち52例は後腹膜リンパ節郭清も受けた。
結果：化学療法後の残存腫瘤の病理所見は、完全壊死、奇形腫、生存癌がそれぞれ31%、55%、14%の患者で認められた。後腹膜リンパ節と胸部（肺または縦隔リンパ節）残存腫瘤との間で病理所見の不一致が27%の患者で認められた。両側肺切除を行った39例中、2例（5%）のみで両肺間の組織学的所見が不一致であった。最初の肺のみに壊死を認めた患者20例のうち、19例（95%）は対側病変にも壊死のみを認めた。最初の肺にのみ壊死があり、対側肺に一部奇形腫を認めた例は1例のみであった。
結論：両肺間で高率（95%）の病理学的一致が認められた。一次導入化学療法後に最初の肺で完全壊死が認められた場合、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対して対側肺手術を回避することを検討しうる。
